canDo: Can make polite requests, give advice and express simple hypotheses with si + imparfait / conditionnel.
input: Listening: complaints and advice; reading: emails asking for help/giving advice.
output: Write a 120-word email of advice; give 4 pieces of advice aloud in 2 minutes, with explanations.
checkpoint: At least 4 conditional forms; avoid errors such as si je serais.
challenge: Today’s challenge: imagine a friend has been sleeping badly lately; write them 4 pieces of advice in French (Tu devrais…, À ta place, je…, Si j’étais toi, je…), each with a reason; you can first look up a health expression to review on TV5MONDE or Le Point du FLE.

questions.why: The fault is an automatic shutdown below zero. Three rooms relying on temporary heaters is a consequence, not a description of the boiler’s fault.
The first demand is a repair visit as soon as possible; replacing the appliance is the fallback « Si une réparation n'était pas possible ».
« je saisirais le médiateur … Je préférerais évidemment éviter cette démarche » — the conditional leaves room for manoeuvre.
« Il pourrait chercher une cause précise plutôt que prescrire d'emblée un somnifère »; the threshold for seeing a doctor is one month.
Footfall does eventually rise, but with a lag of 12–18 months, and « peu de commerces peuvent absorber une année difficile ».
The first step is a registered letter stating the precise facts; mediation is the next step « si ça ne suffit pas ».
« Ce n'est pas un tribunal : personne n'est obligé d'accepter le résultat », and it’s free.
« si on cloisonnait, on perdrait la lumière du fond », so glass partitions are needed, which are expensive.
The ending gives the order clearly: glass partitions come last, depending on the budget.
« Sans ces éléments, l'attente serait beaucoup plus longue » — a longer wait, not being turned away.
One of the three red-flag symptoms is weakness on one side of the body: call 15 immediately.

V15-15.exZh: Let’s imagine the square is closed to traffic.

V15-16.exZh: This delivery slot works, provided it is actually enforced.

V15-21.exZh: If repair is impossible, replacing the appliance should be considered.

V15-23.exZh: If the problems last more than a month, talk to your doctor about it.

V15-24.exZh: Get up at the same time every day, including at the weekend.

V15-28.exZh: Without an agenda sent the day before, the meeting would be cancelled.

V15-29.exZh: Send your letter by recorded delivery with acknowledgement of receipt.

title: Politeness, advice and hypotheses
